name: suganthan-gsc-mcp
description: Google Search Console MCP server for Claude. Fork of Suganthans-GSC-MCP v2.5.1 with 33 SEO analysis tools: everything upstream ships (quick wins, traffic drops, content decay, cannibalisation, CTR opportunities, multi-site dashboards, the image-search suite, generative AI conversation-query detection, image page audit) plus discover_analysis, image_analysis, search_appearance and query_count, a dimension guard, device/country filters, measured click curves, and service-account keys from a secret manager. OAuth and service account support.
author: Suganthan Mohanadasan
